summary: COSE defines signed and encrypted messages encoded in CBOR. This document adds the algorithm identifiers and key representations needed to use RSA with COSE, including RSA-PSS signatures and RSAES-OAEP encryption.

eli5.summary: COSE is a way to seal small digital messages. This adds one more kind of lock and key, called RSA, that people can choose to use.

questions: how to use rsa with cose
